name: Kuon Shikka
source:
An employee at the Ministry of Education and [url=/c153056]Honoka Kokushikan[/url]'s subordinate. Under her boss's orders, she dons a disguise and infiltrates Shuten Academy as a student in order to assist [url=/c153020]Rei Shimobe[/url] in the "romance game".

[spoiler]She is actually the secret 4th Kokushikan at the school and one of Honoka's many disguises at the fake Academy.[/spoiler]
